item.title: eDrivers
item.description: eDrivers is an open knowledge platform focused on sharing knowledge on the distribution and intensity of environmental drivers such as shipping and commercial fisheries. This application provides a user interface to visualize the distribution and intensity of individual and combined drivers in the estuary and gulf of St. Lawrence.
